Class Intersection

java.lang.Object
net.murat.math.Intersection
public class Intersection extends Object
Represents the geometric hit data when a ray intersects an object. Fully optimized to be reused in performance-critical loops without object allocation.

    • set

      public Intersection set(Point3 point, Vector3 normal, double distance, EMShape shape)
      PERFORMANCE METHOD: Updates all fields of this existing intersection instance in-place. This eliminates the need for calling 'new Intersection(...)' in hot rendering loops.
